from qiskit.circuit.library import RealAmplitudes

def solve_dual_instrument_telescope():
    """
    Solves the dual-instrument telescope scheduling problem using a hybrid quantum-classical approach (QAOA).

    qubo_linear = {

        "x4": -36,

        "x3x4": 20,

    }

        "x6x7": 20,
        "x6x8": 20,
        "x6x9": 20,
        "x6x10": 20,
        "x7x8": 20,
        "x7x9": 20,
        "x7x10": 20,
        "x8x9": 20,
        "x8x10": 20,
        "x9x10": 20
    }

    cross_instrument_conflicts = {
        "x2x7": 12,
        "x4x9": 12
    }

    # Define constraints
    constraints = [
        {"type": "equality", "expression": "x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 = 3", "description": "Instrument alpha has exactly 3 observation slots"},
        {"type": "equality", "expression": "x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10 = 3", "description": "Instrument beta has exactly 3 observation slots"},
        {"type": "cross_instrument_conflict", "expression": "x2 * x7 = 0", "description": "T2 and T7 conflict"},
        {"type": "cross_instrument_conflict", "expression": "x4 * x9 = 0", "description": "T4 and T9 conflict"}
    ]

    # Define penalty parameters
    penalty_alpha = 10
    penalty_beta = 10
    penalty_t2t7 = 12
    penalty_t4t9 = 12

    # Objective function

        "selected_alpha": selected_alpha,
        "selected_beta": selected_beta
    }
